text.headline: Timeline of Vatican City
text.text: Major events in the history of Vatican City, the center of the Roman Catholic Church.

events.headline: Martyrdom of Saint Peter
events.text: Saint Peter is martyred and buried on Vatican Hill, marking the site’s sacred origins.

events.headline: Old St. Peter’s Basilica
events.text: Emperor Constantine builds the first basilica over Peter’s tomb.

events.headline: Papal States Established
events.text: Donation of Pepin grants the Pope territorial rule over central Italy.

events.headline: Roman Question
events.text: Italian unification ends the Papal States’ rule over Rome.

events.headline: Lateran Treaty
events.text: Vatican City becomes an independent sovereign state.

events.headline: Second Vatican Council
events.text: Council convened to modernize church practices.

events.headline: Pope Francis Elected
events.text: First Jesuit and Latin American pope.

events.headline: Outreach & Reform
events.text: Reforms with emphasis on interfaith dialogue and climate responsibility.
